note: Curated 12-repo pilot for the Yuhi v0.3.1 OSS benchmark. Mix of categories, deliberately including repositories where reduction is expected to be ~0%. All measured from an actual fresh `git clone --depth 1` at HEAD with the DEFAULT `yuhi init` config — no junk added, no per-repo config tuning. Commit hash is resolved at clone time by the runner.
config_policy: default yuhi.yaml from `yuhi init`, identical for every repo

repositories.name: expressjs/express
repositories.reason: Popular, clean JS library — a fresh clone is source+tests+docs only. Expected reduction ~0% (baseline that Yuhi correctly finds little to remove).

repositories.name: sindresorhus/ky
repositories.reason: Small, modern TypeScript HTTP library. Clean single-package repo; expected low reduction.

repositories.name: pallets/click
repositories.reason: Clean Python CLI library with docs. Expected low reduction; tests presence of Python handling.

repositories.name: tiangolo/typer
repositories.reason: Python library, docs-heavy (MkDocs). Some markdown/image docs — tests document handling.

repositories.name: d3/d3
repositories.reason: Commits a built dist/ bundle. Expected some reduction if build output is routed out.

repositories.name: moment/moment
repositories.reason: Ships many locale files + committed min/build output; larger tree. Tests build/large-file handling (may be slow).

repositories.name: chartjs/Chart.js
repositories.reason: Charting library that historically commits dist/ + docs. Mixed source/build.

repositories.name: datasciencedojo/datasets
repositories.reason: Repository of CSV datasets — mostly data, little source. Strong candidate for real reduction (data kept local / de-identified).

repositories.name: plotly/datasets
repositories.reason: CSV/JSON sample datasets. Data-heavy; expected higher reduction (may be large — timeout is a valid result).

repositories.name: rougier/numpy-100
repositories.reason: Jupyter notebooks (with outputs) + Python. Tests notebook-output handling.

repositories.name: openai/openai-cookbook
repositories.reason: Large notebook/data repo with embedded outputs and images. Likely slow / may time out — recorded honestly.

repositories.name: YUHI-AI-Labs/yuhi
repositories.reason: Dogfood: measure Yuhi on its own fresh clone (monorepo with docs, examples/demo, tests). No junk added.
